description: This file defines the TaskRecyclerListener interface, specifying callback methods for task-related user interactions within a RecyclerView, such as dragging, status change, content change, and navigating to the next item.

classes.name: TaskRecyclerListener
classes.description: An interface that provides callback methods to handle user interactions on task items within a recycler view.

methods.name: onDrag
methods.description: Called when a task item is being dragged.

methods.name: onTaskStatusChanged
methods.description: Called when a task's completion status is changed.

methods.name: onTaskContentChanged
methods.description: Called when the content of a task is modified.

methods.name: onNext
methods.description: Called to navigate to the next task item.
